name: Tooling
purpose: the shared TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, knip, markdownlint, commitlint and lefthook configuration every layer extends, on Bun and Turborepo
check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck

name: Domain
purpose: the pure policy rules: reading policy definitions, resolving and editing policy state, with no I/O framework
check: bun run typecheck && bun run test

name: Contracts
purpose: the Effect Schema types and HttpApi contract, and the OpenAPI document generated from it
check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run openapi:check

name: Data
purpose: the PostgreSQL schema, Drizzle on Effect SQL repositories and Drizzle Kit migrations
check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run migrations:check

name: Services
purpose: the Effect HttpApi service implementing the contract on Bun, and serving the OpenAPI document
check: bun run typecheck && bun run test

name: Components
purpose: the shadcn on Base UI components, Tailwind theme and lucide icons, documented in Storybook
check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run storybook:build

name: Screens
purpose: the server rendered TanStack Start screens, routes, queries, forms and Paraglide messages
check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build

name: Black-box tests
purpose: the Playwright and axe tests that drive the running product through its screens and API
check: bun run typecheck && bun run test:list
